newsitem.title: USA: AOL up on bullish views of partner meeting.
newsitem.headline: AOL up on bullish views of partner meeting.

text.p: Shares of America Online Inc jumped on bullish views from some analysts attending AOL's partners' conference in Phoenix, Ariz., traders said.
"I heard it's going very, very well," one trader said.

Also, at a Jupiter Communications conference in New York on Tuesday, the president of AOL Services, Ted Leonsis, said November was the best month ever for AOL in terms of advertising and usage. He declined to give specifics.
"All I can say is, it was a great month," Leonsis said.
An AOL spokesman said the company would release its subscriber, usage and advertising data at the end of December.
"We are not releasing subscriber numbers at the conference," an AOL spokesman said.
Shares of AOL were up 2-1/2 to 40, a rise of 6.6 percent. The shares were among the most active issues on the New York Stock Exchange.

Brian Oakes, a Lehman Brothers analyst, wrote in a research report on Monday that he expects some very positive news to come out of the partners' conference, such as that subscriber growth in November would be the highest in company history, "probably over 300,000."
The AOL spokesman declined comment on this forecast.
